label: 사람인 Saramin
terms_note: Open API for job search (key on approval; no client yet); online CV apply.

endpoints.call: api for search — Saramin 채용정보 API (GET https://oapi.saramin.co.kr/job-search?access-key=…, JSON or XML) after the application → approval → app registration flow;
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: the job-postings API allows at most 500 calls per day (채용정보 API는 1일 최대 500회 호출 가능). Developer must apply for use (이용신청) and be approved by e-mail, then register an app to receive an access-key; the job- postings API allows at most 500 calls per day (채용정보 API는 1일 최대 500회 호출 가능). Intended for custom job-search sites, widgets and mash-ups; user notice (서비스 이용자 주의사항) page exists; contact api@saramin.co.kr. Nothing about applying — candidates apply on saramin.co.kr.

fields.name: access_key
fields.help: access-key issued after Saramin approves your API application (이용신청) and you register an app at https://oapi.saramin.co.kr/.

adapter.rate_note: 채용정보 API는 1일 최대 500회 호출 가능 (500 calls per day); error code 4 means the daily quota is exhausted.

search.note: GET /job-search with Accept: application/json: keywords (company, title, keyword and duty text), start = 0-based page number, count ≤ 110 (default 10); fields=posting-date adds the ISO posting date. loc_cd takes region codes, so location is not sent. jobs.total is a string in the sample, so total is null. salary is a code + text range (in raw). Failures arrive as {code, message} (1/2 bad key, 3 bad parameter, 4 daily quota).

not_offered.me: No account endpoint; the access-key is the only credential.
not_offered.get_posting: The guide documents only the job-search operation (no per-id detail call); each hit's url is the Saramin posting page.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint; applicants apply on saramin.co.kr.
